### Codere Online Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


11/12/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s29.q4cdn.com/160319267/files/content_files/Codere-Online-Q3-2026-Press-Release.pdf)


**Revenue of €62.6 million (+31%), Adj. EBITDA of €4.2 million (+45%), and** **Gaming Win of €67.1 million (+30%) in the quarter**


- Total revenue was €62.6 mm in Q3 2026 (+31%): Spain €24.8 mm (+13%) and Mexico €32.9 mm (+37%).
- Adj. EBITDA reached €4.2 mm in Q3 2026, 45% (€1.3 mm) above Q3 2025.
- Net income was €11.1 mm in 9M 2026, versus a net loss of €1.7 mm in 9M 2025.
- Gaming Win1 was €67.1 mm in Q3 2026 (+30%): Spain €24.8 mm (+13%) and Mexico €37.2 mm (+39%).
- Total cash position of €65.6 mm and no financial debt as of September 30, 2026.
- Reiterating FY 2026 outlook of €255-265 mm of Gaming Win and €20-25 mm of Adj. EBITDA2.


**Madrid, Spain and Tel Aviv, Israel, November 12, 2026** – (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. (Nasdaq: CDRO / CDROW, the “Company” or “Codere Online”), a leading online gaming operator in Spain and Latin America, has released its preliminary unaudited3 financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Below are the main financial and operating metrics of the period.

Aviv Sher, Chief Executive Officer of Codere Online, commented, “Q3 was another quarter of strong growth, with Gaming Win up 30% year-on-year, driven mainly by Mexico, up 39%, and continued growth in Spain. During the quarter we also became Official Betting Partner of the NFL in Mexico, which further strengthens our positioning in one of our most important markets.”


Marcus Arildsson, CFO of Codere Online, commented, “We delivered €62.6 million of revenue and Adjusted EBITDA of €4.2 million in the quarter, as well as €67.1 million of Gaming Win, while continuing to invest behind growth. We closed September with approximately €66 million of total cash and no financial debt.”


Mr. Arildsson further added, "Following a strong third quarter, we remain confident about meeting our full year 2026 outlook of €255 – 265 million of Gaming Win and €20 – 25 million of Adjusted EBITDA. Our third quarter benefited from the final stages of the World Cup in July and from favorable exchange rates, and against a strong fourth quarter last year, we expect growth in the coming months to be more in line with our underlying trends.”


**Recent Events**


**Official Betting Partner of the NFL in Mexico**


- On September 10, 2026, Codere Online announced a multi-year agreement to become Official Betting Partner of the NFL in Mexico, strengthening its premium brand positioning in one of its largest and most strategically important markets.
- The agreement includes sponsorship of the 2026 NFL Mexico City Game, to be held in Mexico City on November 22, 2026, and of Super Bowl LXI, to be held in Los Angeles in February 2027.
- It also provides a year-round platform for customer engagement, including hospitality programs, VIP experiences, activations across multiple cities in Mexico and official NFL merchandise opportunities.


**Transition from Net Gaming Revenue to Gaming Win**


- Beginning this quarter, Codere Online reports Gaming Win as a key operating metric in place of the measure previously presented as “Net Gaming Revenue”. Gaming Win is a key operating metric that measures the cash amount we retain from our customers’ wagering activity: amounts staked by customers on settled sports betting and casino wagers, less prizes and promotional credits paid to customers, before gaming taxes, value added taxes, other levies and all other costs and adjustments, as compiled by our gaming platforms and translated into euros at average monthly exchange rates (as applicable).
- Historical amounts previously reported as “Net Gaming Revenue” are unchanged and Codere Online’s FY 2026 outlook is reiterated on the same basis by reference to Gaming Win.
- Gaming Win is not a measure of Revenue and should not be considered an alternative to Revenue or any other financial measure determined in accordance with IFRS.

**About Codere Online**


Codere Online refers, collectively, to Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. and its subsidiaries. Codere Online, launched in 2014 as part of the renowned casino operator Codere Group, offers online sports betting and online casino through its state-of-the art website and mobile applications. Codere Online currently operates in its core markets of Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Panama and Argentina; this online business is complemented by Codere Group’s physical presence in Spain and throughout Latin America, forming the foundation of the leading omnichannel gaming and casino presence.


**About Codere Group**
Codere Group is a multinational group dedicated to entertainment and leisure. It is a leading player in the private gaming industry, with four decades of experience and with presence in seven countries in Europe (Spain and Italy) and Latin America (Argentina, Colombia, Mexico, Panama, and Uruguay).

**Key Operating Metrics**
This document includes certain key operating metrics, such as Gaming Win and average monthly active players, which management uses to manage and assess the performance of the business. Gaming Win measures the cash amount we retain from our customers’ wagering activity: amounts staked by customers on settled sports betting and casino wagers, less prizes and promotional credits paid to customers, before gaming taxes, value added taxes, other levies and all other costs and adjustments, as compiled by our gaming platforms and translated into euros at average monthly exchange rates (as applicable). We use Gaming Win for budgeting and planning, monthly management and Board reporting, and assessing performance by market and product. Codere Online believes it is useful to investors because the taxes applicable to online gaming differ among our markets, and Gaming Win allows activity to be compared on a consistent basis. Gaming Win replaces the measure previously presented as "Net Gaming Revenue", and historical amounts are unchanged. Gaming Win is not a measure of revenue and should not be considered an alternative to revenue or any other IFRS measure. These metrics may not be comparable to similarly titled measures used by other companies.

This document includes certain financial measures not presented in accordance with IFRS, such as Adjusted EBITDA. Codere Online believes these measures are useful to investors in evaluating its operating results and trends, but they are subject to limitations, may exclude items that are significant to understanding its financial results, and may not be comparable to similarly titled measures used by other companies. They should not be considered in isolation or as an alternative to revenue, net income, cash flows from operations or any other measure determined in accordance with IFRS. Reconciliations to the most directly comparable IFRS measures are included in this document. Codere Online does not provide a reconciliation of forward-looking Adjusted EBITDA to net income because it cannot predict, without unreasonable effort, certain items that would be required, such as finance results, foreign exchange effects and income taxes, which could be material.
